data.name: Catch Sunlight Museum
data.detailed_description:
Our mission is to elevate digital art by providing a beautifully curated, high-class virtual museum where every piece is given the space and respect it deserves. We showcase art from around the world in immersive, thoughtfully designed environments—free to explore and free to submit. In a digital world where artwork is often lost in endless feeds, we offer a dedicated space where each artist’s voice can stand out and be truly seen. We plan to add new curated exhibits regularly. 

If you’re a digital artist—whether you create images, 3D objects, music, VFX, or other digital formats—we invite you to be part of this immersive, high-class platform designed to make art stand out, not get lost in a feed. Please Submit your art on our Catch Sunlight Museum Website. 

We welcome creativity in many forms—but please note that we reserve the right to curate and display submissions as we see best for the overall experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card with at least 6GB VRAM (like an NVIDIA GTX 1070 or higher).
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X or Intel Core i7-10700K.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB) or NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
